mapper.select:
SELECT A.UNQ_KY_VAL, A.PRCDOC_UNQ_KY_VAL, B.DIVS_CD, B.PPCD, A.CHCK_DY, REGEXP_REPLACE(A.CHCK_DY, '(.{4})(.{2})(.{2})','\1-\2-\3') AS FM_CHCK_DY, A.CHKPR_FNM, B.PRCDOC_NO, B.PRCDOC_NM, B.RRD_CFY, A.REGPR_ID, A.REGPR_NM, A.RG_DT, TO_CHAR(A.RG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS FM_RG_DT FROM GE_MP_SCHE_S A JOIN GE_MP_PRCDOC_M B ON A.PRCDOC_UNQ_KY_VAL = B.PRCDOC_UNQ_KY_VAL
AND B.PPCD = #{PPCD}
AND B.PRCDOC_NO LIKE '%'||#{PRCDOC_NO}||'%'
AND B.PRCDOC_NM LIKE '%'||#{PRCDOC_NM}||'%'
WHERE 1 = 1
AND A.CHKPR_FNM = #{CHKPR_FNM}
AND A.CHCK_DY BETWEEN #{CHCK_DY_S} AND #{CHCK_DY_E} ORDER BY RG_DT DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO GE_MP_SCHE_S ( UNQ_KY_VAL, PRCDOC_UNQ_KY_VAL, CHCK_DY, CHKPR_FNM, REGPR_ID, REGPR_NM, RG_DT ) VALUES ( (SELECT NVL(MAX(UNQ_KY_VAL), 0) +1 FROM GE_MP_SCHE_S), #{PRCDOC_UNQ_KY_VAL}, #{CHCK_DY}, #{CHKPR_FNM}, #{REGPR_ID}, #{REGPR_NM}, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE GE_MP_SCHE_S SET CHCK_DY = #{CHCK_DY}, CHKPR_FNM = #{CHKPR_FNM}, REGPR_ID = #{REGPR_ID}, REGPR_NM = #{REGPR_NM}, RG_DT = SYSDATE WHERE UNQ_KY_VAL = #{UNQ_KY_VAL}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM GE_MP_SCHE_S WHERE UNQ_KY_VAL IN (${CHK_ITEMS})
